name: the candidate list stops excluding a customer with a pending Add ID
the claim stops refusing a pending Add ID draft for the same code
find:
SELECT 1 FROM draft d
      WHERE d.id<>?1 AND ${unfolded(at, 'd.')} AND d.status IN ('pending','approved')
        AND json_valid(d.entry) AND json_extract(d.entry,'$.payload.mode')='addid'
replace:
SELECT 1 FROM draft d
      WHERE 0 AND d.id<>?1 AND ${unfolded(at, 'd.')} AND d.status IN ('pending','approved')
        AND json_valid(d.entry) AND json_extract(d.entry,'$.payload.mode')='addid'
